page_title: crterm — a beautifully opinionated macOS terminal emulator

summary.name: crterm
summary.one_liner: crterm is a native, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for macOS with a session search palette, split panes, and optional retro CRT-style themes.
use_cases: switch quickly between many terminal sessions
search past shell commands and output
work in split panes within one window
use a retro CRT-style terminal look
summary.what_it_does: The page describes crterm as a native, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for macOS. A command palette (⌘K) searches sessions by name, command, or content. Sessions and windows can be created, switched, and closed with keyboard shortcuts, and panes can be split right or down. Search covers find, find next/previous, command history, and all history, and previous/next prompt navigation is available. Session themes include Dark, Light, Danger, and several retro CRT-style themes (IBM 5151, DEC VT220, Amdek 310A, Commodore 1702, RPG).
notable: Session search palette that matches session names, commands, and content
Optional retro CRT themes such as IBM 5151, DEC VT220, and Commodore 1702
Keyboard-focused navigation with prompt jumping and command history search
caveats: Only macOS is named on the page
Page does not describe installation requirements or a version number
